title: 14 yoshda maktabni tashlagan bola nimani qurdi?

scenes.text: Taxminan 1950 yilda 14 yoshli Amansio Ortega maktabni tashlab, ko'ylak do'konida yugurdak bo'lib ishlay boshladi.
scenes.keywords: young boy delivering package old street

scenes.text: U kiyim qanday tikilishini va qanday sotilishini ichidan ko'rdi.
1975 yilda u Ispaniyaning La-Korunya shahrida birinchi do'konini ochdi. Nomi Zara edi.
Zara keyin Inditex guruhining asosiy brendiga aylandi. 2001 yilda Inditex birjaga chiqdi.
Bir paytlar yugurdak bo'lgan bola dunyodagi eng boy odamlardan biriga aylandi.

description:
Amansio Ortega 1936 yilda tug'ilgan, taxminan 14 yoshida La-Korunyadagi ko'ylak do'konida yugurdak bo'lib ishlay boshlagan. 1975 yilda birinchi Zara do'konini ochgan. Inditex 2001 yilda birjaga chiqqan.

Sizni nima ko'proq hayratga soldi: boshlanishimi yoki natijasimi? Izohda yozing.
source: Fact-checked 2026-11-22 (via web search summaries; direct page fetch was blocked). Britannica: Amancio Ortega, https://www.britannica.com/biography/Amancio-Ortega (born 28 Mar 1936; delivery boy for a men's shirt store and assistant in a tailor's shop in A Coruna); Fortune 2013, https://www.fortune.com/2013/01/08/meet-amancio-ortega-the-third-richest-man-in-the-world/ (first job at the shirtmaker Gala, first Zara store two blocks away; one of the richest men); Wikipedia: Amancio Ortega (left school at 14; some sources say 13, so the age is hedged; first Zara store May 1975, Juan Florez St, A Coruna); Wikipedia: Inditex and Inditex 2001 annual report (IPO 23 May 2001, Madrid exchange; Zara flagship brand). The year 1950 is derived from birth year plus age 14, so it is hedged with 'taxminan'.
